load_parameters_from_config: load a Parameters object from a config file path using Parameters.load or get_parameters
extract_task_goals: extract the object_to_find and location_to_place task goals from a Parameters instance using get_task_goals
create_parameters_instance: create a Parameters instance by passing keyword arguments to the Parameters constructor
access_parameter_by_key: access or set a parameter value using bracket notation on a Parameters instance
check_instance_reachable: check the guarantee_instance_is_reachable property on a Parameters instance to see if planning reachability is enabled
